author: Krono I
title: Hybrid Dilation CNN (d=2, d=5)
abstract: This experiment investigates a more nuanced application of dilated convolutions, as suggested by reviewer feedback on my SOTA paper. It tests a hybrid dilation scheme, applying a smaller rate (d=2) to the first residual block and a larger, SOTA-level rate (d=5) to the second. The hypothesis is that this approach will effectively capture both local and global spatial patterns, potentially outperforming a uniform dilation rate.
